name: Hastra Wrapped YLDS
oneLiner: Hastra wYLDS is a fixed-dollar yield-bearing token on Ethereum and Solana backed by Figure YLDS and Prime (formerly Democratized Prime) lending reserves.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 PR-4 review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hastra describes wYLDS as a proportionate ownership interest in a reserve pool referencing tracked Figure YLDS (ylds-figure), yet combined Ethereum and Solana wYLDS supply ($540.80M as of 2026-11-27) exceeds total Provenance YLDS supply ($301.34M) because reserves also allocate to Figure Prime (formerly Democratized Prime) private-credit pools. Until reserve deduplication against ylds-figure and the exact holder-claim mechanism are verified, wYLDS remains in review-hold rather than core-stablecoin.

collateral: Hastra deploys wYLDS backing across Figure Certificate Company YLDS on Provenance (tracked as ylds-figure) and Figure Prime (formerly Democratized Prime) private-credit lending pools (HELOC, auto, and SMB credit pools) alongside minor USDC balances. As of 2026-11-27, combined Ethereum and Solana wYLDS supply ($540.80M) exceeds total Provenance uylds.fcc bank supply ($301.34M), reflecting direct credit-pool allocation rather than a 1:1 YLDS wrapper.
pegMechanism: Fixed $1.00 par ERC-4626 and SPL wrapper (Ethereum convertToAssets(1e6) = 1.000000 USDC as of 2026-11-27) whose accrued yield is claimed separately via monthly merkle distributions rather than NAV appreciation. Primary redemptions follow a two-step admin-completed request queue.

proofOfReserves.provider: Hastra Pulse live reserve and supply telemetry

launchPhaseDetail: Hastra wYLDS is publicly issued and open-loop transferable on Ethereum ($307.11M at block 26507604) and Solana ($233.69M at slot 474607859 as of 2026-11-27). Active admission remains blocked by stale and illiquid market pricing (CoinGecko stale since 2026-10-30 with empty tickers; $737 Solana DEX liquidity) and unresolved reserve deduplication and classification scope between Provenance YLDS ($301.34M total supply) and Prime (formerly Democratized Prime) credit-pool claims ($527.08M reported by Hastra Pulse).

milestones.title: Hastra deploys Solana vault-mint program for wYLDS on mainnet
milestones.description: Hastra deploys the Solana vault-mint program (9WUyNREiPDMgwMh5Gt81Fd3JpiCKxpjZ5Dpq9Bo1RhMV) at slot 381402724 governing wYLDS issuance, merkle yield claims, and freeze-administrator controls ahead of CoinGecko market tracking in December 2025.

milestones.title: Hastra publishes Solana vault-mint release v0.0.4
milestones.description: Open-source GitHub release v0.0.4 of Hastra's Solana vault-mint program governing 1:1 USDC-to-wYLDS minting, monthly merkle yield claims, and freeze-administrator controls.

milestones.title: Hastra deploys wYLDS UUPS YieldVault proxy on Ethereum
milestones.description: Hastra deploys the Ethereum wYLDS ERC-4626 UUPS proxy (0x6ad038ca6c04e885630851278ca0a856ad9a66cc) at block 24901860, expanding wYLDS issuance beyond Solana.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane (CoinGecko stale since 2026-10-30; $737 Solana DEX liquidity) and unresolved reserve deduplication and classification scope between Provenance YLDS ($301.34M total supply) and Prime credit pools ($527.08M reported).
